messages:
alisa: Seeing a weird wave of tiny GPU pods Pending -> Bound -> Evicted concentrated on rack-r3 in us-west1 around 07:22 UTC. ~22 evictions in 18m.

maleena: Do we have any taint/label rollouts or topology changes?

alisa: No deploys. Kubelet events on r3 nodes show short 'taint:gpu-unhealthy:NoSchedule' flips, then immediate removal. timing aligns with a spike in conntrack drops on the ToR.

sangeeta: conntrack? That would delay kubelet health checks and controller heartbeats, causing the scheduler to treat nodes as transiently unschedulable. When that flips back pods get bounced.
devon: Paste from node logs:
```
Apr 12 07:21:58 kubelet: marking node r3-node-12 as tainted: gpu-unhealthy
Apr 12 07:22:03 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Apr 12 07:22:07 kubelet: removed taint gpu-unhealthy
Apr 12 07:22:15 eviction-controller: evicting pod small-train-1 due to preempt
```

opsbot: Alert: rack-r3 conntrack-drops -> taint-flip correlated with tiny-gpu evictions. incident INC-5402 created.

maleena: Short-term: throttle taint flips by adding a taint-stabilization window (keep taint for 45s after set) so short conntrack blips don't immediately block scheduling. Also reduce aggressive backfill for pods <0.25 GPU.

sangeeta: +1. Add a quick VPN/ToR telemetry check and bump conntrack table size on affected ToRs as part of remediation. Might be noisy ephemeral workloads causing NAT table exhaustion.

alisa: I'll apply canary: taintStabilization=45s and backfillTinyPodFactor=0.4 to scheduler profile for us-west1-r3 only, and schedule a config change to conntrack on ToR via network-runbook.

devon: Config snippet:
```
{"taintStabilization": "45s", "backfillTinyPodFactor": "0.4"}
```

maleena: Can we also surface a dashboard showing taint flips per rack + conntrack drops so SRE can watch rollback window?
sangeeta: Yup adding a panel now. If evictions drop after the canary, we should bake taint stabilizer into global profile and follow up on ToR conntrack sizing and upstream NAT gateway patterns.
alisa: Canary rolling out to 12 nodes in r3. Will report in 15m. :crossed_fingers:
